name: MeowNet - Hack Her Feed
source:
You match. You talk. Someone is watching her.

MeowNet is a phone visual novel. The whole game lives inside a phone UI — dating, chats with typing and photo blur, a social feed, a growth shop, a gallery, and MeowCam if you install something you probably shouldn’t.

No stage sprites. No campus map. Just the feed — and how far you’ll go behind her back.

[From [url=https://meownet.itch.io/meownet-hack-her-feed]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
匹配成功，畅聊升温——然而，有人正暗中窥视着她。

《MeowNet》是一款手机界面视觉小说。整部游戏完全呈现在一部手机UI之中——涵盖交友匹配、带实时输入提示与照片模糊效果的私聊窗口、社交动态流、养成商店、相册图库，以及当你装上某个本不该安装的软件后开启的“MeowCam”偷窥镜头。

没有舞台式人物立绘，也没有校园大地图。有的只是不断刷新的动态流——以及背着她的时候，你究竟敢越界到何种地步。

[摘自[url=https://meownet.itch.io/meownet-hack-her-feed]itch.io[/url]]
